records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Harbor Labs!
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for setting up Harbor Labs on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account reached first_project day 1 and sent 1 invite (good early signal, noted in slack:9c305aa6), but no key_milestone in 6 days and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:54eac6cc, email:d6c7893d). No tickets, so no blocker visible. 8 days left; momentum stalled but team plan and active teammate keep it plausible.

draft.subject: Quick help getting Harbor Labs' first tasks moving
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Following up on my last note — you've got your first project up and a teammate invited, which is the right start. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is getting real work into that project for you both to pick up.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a 15-minute call this week and walk through how your team's work maps into projects and tasks. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll make it work.

Best,
Nadia
